title: Claim-Evidence Support Record (v1, additive)
description: 28.K.28-II-IMPL (Phase 2). One record per atomic claim judged by the deterministic support layer (runtime/grounding/claim_support.py), which sits strictly AFTER C2 evidence qualification and BESIDE the citation gate. Citation presence != claim support. INTERNAL-ONLY: these records live in grounding/support structures and audit evidence; Consumer surfaces never receive claim_id / evidence_refs / support_reason (28.K.28-II-IMPL §17). Support states are the shadow-frozen four + NOT_APPLICABLE for exempt claim types (C-USER / C-RECOMMENDATION / C-CALCULATION / C-DERIVED / C-UNCERTAIN).

claim_id.description: Stable id of the atomic claim within the turn's support evaluation (e.g. 'C1').

claim_text.description: The atomic claim text (sentence-first + deterministic clause split — never semantic decomposition).

claim_type.description: Shadow-frozen six-type taxonomy. Only C-FACT requires evidence support.

support_status.description: SUPPORTED = evidence explicitly supports the whole claim; PARTIAL = only part of the claim is supported (the composite '等待期90天且全病种覆盖' case); UNSUPPORTED = qualified evidence exists but does not support the claim; CONTRADICTED = evidence conflicts (detect + fail closed; no invented source precedence — OD-5); NOT_APPLICABLE = exempt claim type.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence labels of the C2-QUALIFIED items judged against (e.g. ['E1']).

support_type.description: Strength dimension: DIRECT (number/entity anchored), PARTIAL, CONTRADICTORY, NONE, EXEMPT (claim type not subject to support).

support_reason.description: Deterministic audit reason (anchor coverage counts, contradiction values, exemption class). Never shown to consumers.
